intro.title: SPACES WITH MEANING
intro.subtitle: Artisanal Craft. Authentic Passion. Abiding Purpose.
intro.quote:
“We create high-end residential villas,
some the size of mini-hotels.”
paragraphs: We’re not what you expect. But we are the go-to architecture studio of choice for ultra-luxurious villas and exceptional investment projects. We create spaces with passion and purpose for discerning, prominent individuals, hospitality and developers..

Genuinely down to earth, because that’s in our DNA, we are a refreshingly different, diverse, talented and multi-national team of architecture professionals with global experience, and we always get things done

items.title: PASSION
items.text: We love what we do and believe in going above and beyond to create spaces that make the spirit soar and the soul sing

items.title: CRAFT
items.text: We believe in time-honoured skills honed over generations of master craftsmen (and women)

items.title: CREATIVITY
items.text: We believe we are limited only by our imaginations and celebrate the possibilities of original thought and personal expression

items.title: COLLABORATION
items.text: We work as a team and believe in long-term relationships founded on authenticity, respect & trust

items.title: SUSTAINABILITY
items.text: We believe in building things of lasting value and enduring purpose

founder.title: OUR FOUNDER
founder.quote: "A lot of what drives me professionally can be traced back to the values I grew up with in Scotland."
founder.label: Founder
founder.name: Lee Nellis
founder.bio: Scottish and United Kingdom registered Master Architect, RIBA Chartered Architect (since 2009),RIAS Chartered Architect (since 2009),and UK Registered Architect (ARB) (since 2009) is theowner and founder of Nellis Architecture.
founder.text: After spending 16 years in Dubai acquiring deep regional knowledge and a total of 21 years of international experience, Lee Nellis founded Nellis Architecture in 2023. A strong reputation precedes Lee,and he is very well-known, connected and highly respected in the market. Lee’s referrals and recommendations from clients and colleagues alike are frequently received via word-of-mouth. True to his Scottish heritage, Lee Nellis stands at the helm of this global company, steering its path, with a keen focus on creating bespoke, ultra-luxurious uber-villas, exclusive hospitality developments and valuable investment residences worldwide.

seo.title: Dubai Architecture Studio | Nellis Architecture
seo.description: Nellis Architecture is a Dubai architecture studio. Architectural consultants in Dubai for luxury villas, master planning, interiors and landscape design.
